description.value: Big Crazy Supermarket (柏仁超市) is a Chinese supermarket located in the busy Number 3 Road commercial corridor in Richmond, offering a broad selection of Asian groceries including fresh vegetables, seafood, frozen foods, canned goods, condiments, and specialty snacks from Chinese brands. The store operates an online shopping platform alongside its physical location, suggesting a well-established operation serving Richmond's large Chinese-Canadian community. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond will find a wide variety of grocery staples here, with particular depth in Asian pantry goods.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 45m; rack at 87m; rack at 96m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bigcrazy.ca is operational and confirms this is a Chinese supermarket (柏仁超市) with active product listings across fresh produce, seafood, frozen goods, canned goods, snacks, and household items — stock levels confirm it is open for business. The OSM shop=supermarket tag is consistent with what the website shows. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: The English brand name 'Big Crazy' does not appear to be a direct translation of the Chinese name '柏仁超市' (Bai Ren Supermarket) shown on the website — these are two distinct names used for the same business. Not a cause for exclusion but worth noting.
No phone number is present in OSM or visible in the fetched website content.
OSM address field omits unit number; OSM tag addr:unit=180 indicates the unit is 180 within 4551 Number 3 Road.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible supermarket with an active website and confirmed product inventory; a useful grocery stop for touring cyclists in Richmond.
